info.title: Lapwise — OpenF1 Wrapper API
info.description: Lapwise wraps the [OpenF1](https://openf1.org) historical-tier API, providing a typed, filterable REST interface for Formula 1 data including drivers, laps, pit stops, sessions, stints, weather, and more.

get.description:
Return a static payload confirming the application is running.

Does **not** contact the OpenF1 upstream.

Retrieve Formula 1 **sessions** from the OpenF1 API.

A *session* is a discrete on-track event within a race weekend (e.g. Practice 1, Qualifying, Sprint, or Race).

Upstream source: <https://api.openf1.org/v1/sessions>

All query parameters are optional and combined with AND semantics. `session_key` accepts an integer or the literal `latest`, which OpenF1 resolves to the most-recent session.

parameters.name: session_key

schema.description: Filter by session key. Use an integer for a specific session or the literal `latest` to retrieve the most-recent session.
schema.title: Session Key

parameters.description: Filter by session key. Use an integer for a specific session or the literal `latest` to retrieve the most-recent session.

parameters.name: meeting_key

schema.description: Filter by meeting (race weekend) key.
schema.title: Meeting Key

parameters.name: country_name

schema.description: Filter by country name (e.g. Belgium).
schema.title: Country Name

parameters.description: Filter by country name (e.g. Belgium).

parameters.name: session_name

schema.description: Filter by session name (e.g. Race, Sprint Qualifying).
schema.title: Session Name

parameters.description: Filter by session name (e.g. Race, Sprint Qualifying).

parameters.name: session_type

schema.description: Filter by session type: Race, Qualifying, Practice, or Sprint.

get.description:

Each record represents one lap completed by a driver, including sector times, speed-trap readings, and mini-sector colour codes.

get.description:

get.description:
Retrieve Formula 1 **championship driver standings** from the OpenF1 API.

get.description:
Compute per-driver offensive and defensive overtake statistics from Race and Sprint sessions.

**aggression_score** — percentile rank (0–100) of the driver's `overtake_rate` vs all other drivers in the same sample; 100 = most overtakes made per session. A score above 70 indicates an assertive overtaker; below 30 indicates a driver who rarely makes positions.

**circuit_overtake_avg** — the driver's average overtakes per session specifically at the queried circuit. Only populated when `session_key` is provided or `include_circuit_history=true`; otherwise `null`.

**total_races** is the denominator for `overtake_rate` and `defensive_rate`. Sprint weekends contribute 2 sessions (Sprint + Race) so `total_races` may exceed `sample_races`.

Omitting `driver_number` returns statistics for every driver active in the sample window.

tags.name: OpenF1 wrappers
tags.description: Thin wrappers around the [OpenF1](https://openf1.org) historical-tier API. Each endpoint proxies the corresponding OpenF1 resource, applying optional query-parameter filters before forwarding the request.

tags.name: Analysis
tags.description: Derived and computed endpoints that combine multiple OpenF1 resources to produce higher-level F1 Fantasy insights: driver pace, DNF rates, fastest-lap candidates, overtake profiles, circuit profiles, championship context, qualifying trends, and constructor pit stop performance.

tags.name: Fantasy
tags.description: F1 Fantasy pricing and recommendation data. Provides the 2025 season driver and constructor prices used by the LapwiseF1Agent to construct budget-constrained team recommendations.
